corrections.text: The article quotes 9to5Google as saying, "Users can manage remote agents via antigravity.google.com/remote on mobile devices." The cited article's actual wording is: "You can control them from the existing antigravity.google.com/remote on your phone." The underlying fact — that Antigravity's Remote Agents can be managed from a phone at that URL — is accurate; the quotation marks around the paraphrase were incorrect.
